reference_sql:
WITH multi AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(assigned_at) AS first_assigned_at, MAX(assigned_at) AS last_assigned_at
  FROM ab_assignments
  WHERE test_id = 'AB-2025-01'
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT variant) > 1
),
conv AS (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n_conversions
  FROM ab_conversions
  WHERE test_id = 'AB-2025-01'
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT m.customer_id, m.first_assigned_at, m.last_assigned_at, COALESCE(v.n_conversions, 0) AS n_conversions
FROM multi m
LEFT JOIN conv v ON v.customer_id = m.customer_id
ORDER BY m.customer_id

solver.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MIN(assigned_at) AS first_assigned_at,
    MAX(assigned_at) AS last_assigned_at
  FROM ab_assignments
  WHERE test_id = 'AB-2025-01'
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT variant) > 1
)
SELECT
  d.customer_id,
  d.first_assigned_at,
  d.last_assigned_at,
  COUNT(c.customer_id) AS n_conversions
FROM d
LEFT JOIN ab_conversions c
  ON c.test_id = 'AB-2025-01'
 AND c.customer_id = d.customer_id
GROUP BY d.customer_id, d.first_assigned_at, d.last_assigned_at
ORDER BY d.customer_id
